text: むしポケモンは　しんかが　はやくて　たのしいよな！

structure.jp: しんかが　はやくて

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: くて joins adjectives, giving a reason or listing. はやくてたのしい = 'fast and so fun'.

patterns.name: 〜よな
patterns.explanation: よな is a casual ending seeking agreement. たのしいよな = 'it's fun, isn't it'.
